deprecated_air_quality.description:
The openSenseMap air quality entity (`{entity_id}`) is deprecated. The particulate matter measurements it provided are now available as individual sensor entities.

Update your dashboards and templates to use those sensor entities, then disable the air quality entity to have it removed after the next restart.
